name: resource-aware-queue
goal: Coordinate CPU and memory across Harness sessions, retain 10 percent CPU headroom, prioritize agent-needed tests and monitor running work without disturbing unrelated processes

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Reserve 10% CPU and max(10% RAM, 2 GiB); prioritize agent tests, finish running tests under pressure; feature spec records integration and proof boundaries.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Shared atomic SQLite admission, fail-closed host probes, bounded nested budgets, managed commands, verification/loop/Desktop integration and worker caps implemented.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 51 focused tests pass across 15 files; 12 native provider tests pass. Red evidence covers missing CLI, process observers, nested oversubscription and CommonJS loading; full verification remains pending.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
Standalone workspace checks and native builds obey admission and worker budgets.
steps.evidence: Existing workspace config suite rejects 8 ungated package entrypoints before repair and passes all 10 cases after wrapping. Native build stand-in rejects missing worker budgets (exit 66) before repair, then all 4 unchanged ownership/build cases pass; real Xcode is not launched.

steps.title: Managed scripts preserve caller arguments and native build parallelism.
steps.evidence: Actual root and Desktop formatter scripts dropped --version before repair; the same CLI cases now pass. All 8 workspace inventories enforce argument forwarding on shell wrappers. Native build stand-ins prove the admitted -jobs value and preserve ownership cleanup.
